items.question: What did federal investigators conclude set off the blaze below decks on the bulk carrier Lem Verbena while it was tied up in Mobile?
items.expected_answer: A failed O-ring seal on the oil fittings block of the composite boiler's burner unit, caused by radial misalignment of the two fuel ports on the block modules, let pressurized diesel fuel atomize and ignite on a nearby hot surface.

evidence.quote: The National Transportation Safety Board determines that the probable cause of the fire on the bulk carrier Lem Verbena was the failure of an O-ring seal on the composite boiler burner unit oil fittings block due to the radial misalignment of the two fuel ports on the block modules, causing pressurized diesel fuel to atomize and ignite on a nearby hot surface.

items.notes: Tests the probable cause; the casualty summary table contains no causal information (only the category Fire/Explosion), so the evidence comes from the probable cause section instead of summary_table.
